title: Distributed AI Inference Engine — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Runs model inference across multiple computing resources. The Distributed AI Inference Engine spreads model-inference work across multiple machines: request batching, model sharding across workers, and result aggregation. It plans batch sizes against latency budgets, balances load across workers, and reports throughput and tail latency. An inference-serving design for capacity planning. Capability specification and design target: this database describes what the tool must do, not a claim of implementation or deployment. Defensive and engineering content only — no weapon-targeting or attack-execution content.
